title: Advisory follow-up and feature-use explanations
summary: This topic is mostly made up of follow-up advisory statements and feature explanations, with only a few clearly negative comments about troublesome issues, upgrade restart guidance, or a broader complaint claim.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention an issue described as troublesome, advice to move the vehicle outside and restart an upgrade if it fails, and a customer claim that the problem is not a one-off case.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly contain service-style explanations or usage guidance about data transfer, location settings, preconditioning, safety warnings, profiles, controls, and naming differences without enough context to judge sentiment.

limitations: The topic is loosely clustered around follow-up phrasing such as 'writer further advised' rather than a single vehicle issue or feature.
Most examples are undetermined service or explanatory fragments, so the underlying customer sentiment is often unclear.
Several fragments are truncated or highly contextual, which limits precise interpretation of the underlying problem or outcome.
